ideas.title: AI-Powered Personal Finance Coach
ideas.description: Build an app that connects to your bank accounts and uses AI to analyze spending habits, suggest savings goals, and create personalized investment strategies. The system would learn your lifestyle and provide actionable weekly nudges — not generic advice, but hyper-personalized coaching based on your real transactions.
ideas.author: Priya Sharma

comments.author: Jordan Lee
comments.text: This is exactly what I've been looking for! Would love to beta test.

comments.author: Marco Rossi
comments.text: The privacy angle here is tricky — how do you handle bank credential security?

collaborationNotes.author: Priya Sharma
collaborationNotes.text: Need to finalize the bank API integration approach by end of week.

ideas.title: Hyperlocal Skill Exchange Network
ideas.description: A neighborhood-based platform where people trade skills instead of money. A graphic designer gets cooking lessons; a plumber gets guitar lessons. The app uses time-credits as currency and AI-matches complementary skill sets.
ideas.author: Marcus Webb

comments.author: Aiko Tanaka
comments.text: Time banks have been tried before — what's the key differentiator here?

collaborationRequests.message: Love this idea! I'd love to contribute my UX skills.

ideas.title: Ambient Productivity OS
ideas.description: An operating system layer that sits on top of your existing OS and learns your deep work rhythms. It automatically dims distracting apps during focus windows, surfaces relevant documents before you need them, and gives you a weekly cognitive report.
ideas.author: Sofia Chen

collaborationNotes.author: Sofia Chen
collaborationNotes.text: Looking for a backend engineer to prototype the OS hook layer.

ideas.title: Micro-Documentary Social Platform
ideas.description: 90-second vertical documentaries only. No vlogs, no selfies — just tiny, crafted short-docs about overlooked subjects: the night shift nurse, the last typewriter repairman, the urban beekeeper.
ideas.author: Dev Anand

comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.text: Love this concept. The 90-second constraint is a genius forcing function.
